concept: Reel-to-reel contactless REBCO tape quality metrology (Hall-array critical-current mapping + delamination screening) sold to tape vendors and magnet builders as certified acceptance instrumentation.
timing_window: Tape vendors may bundle 'good-enough' in-house QC data; if one instrument maker partners exclusively with the largest vendor, the neutral-referee position is lost.

concept: Electrolyzer stack degradation-emulation and bankability test systems: programmable ripple/intermittency benches that turn stack warranties into measurable engineering
timing_window: Hydrogen demand volatility caps growth (order books shrinking now, L11-047/048) - but the seed monetizes uncertainty itself; worst case is a slow niche, not a zero. Export separability excellent (test equipment; CN entity straightforward). Kill if neither market yields bench sales nor paid campaigns by end-2033.

concept: Merchant quench-detection-and-protection subsystem for REBCO/HTS magnets: co-wound distributed fiber-optic sensing plus sub-millisecond active energy extraction, sold with a qualification dossier to fusion companies and national labs.
timing_window: If no-insulation windings prove fully sufficient at pilot-plant scale, the detection problem shrinks; if a magnet builder open-sources a good solution, differentiation collapses to service/qualification.

concept: Solid-state microsecond impedance-matching engines (switched SiC/PIN capacitor arrays replacing motorized vacuum-capacitor matchboxes) for pulsed and tailored-waveform RF plasma tools
timing_window: If AE/MKS ship integrated solid-state matching as a standard feature before a merchant module gains a design win, the socket closes; mitigated by selling to the same incumbents and to CN OEMs the US incumbents cannot serve.

concept: 800-VDC rack power-path protection: integrated solid-state breaker + precharge/inrush control + insulation monitoring + hot-swap sequencing unit for AI racks and power sidecars
timing_window: Export-control separability: good - protection electronics are conventional industrial power electronics (largely EAR99); China variant can use domestic GaN/SiC (Innoscience, L02-050) built by a licensed CN entity while the US entity serves OCP customers; main risks are hyperscaler vertical integration, UL/IEC certification timeline, and any future US controls on high-performance power semiconductors. 2026 specs/prices must be refreshed in 2029.

concept: Qualified diamond transmission-dynode membrane and integration cartridge for hybrid MCP-PMTs used in EIC-class photon detectors
timing_window: EIC Detector II may never receive construction funding, Exosens or Incom may close the collection-efficiency gap without a dynode, or BNL may internalize the process after the LDRD. Do not count base-ePIC procurement. Kill the commercial thesis at end-2029 unless a US lab or tube maker pays for qualification or writes the cartridge into a funded post-freeze detector plan.

concept: Multi-terminal DC fault-discrimination protection relay plus vendor-neutral hardware-in-the-loop qualification platform for MVDC datacenter distribution and HVDC converter stations - the 'SEL of DC grids.'
timing_window: If US/offshore DC stays point-to-point through 2034, fast discrimination demand defers; converter vendors may refuse third-party protection in their stations.

concept: Retrofit X-ray computed-laminography kit for advanced-packaging failure analysis
timing_window: JCET's Lingang advanced-packaging factory has phase-one production-equipment completion targeted for H2 2028, while the official 2026-2030 national plan calls for decisive integrated-circuit breakthroughs. A 2030 launch enters the post-installation yield-learning and recurring failure-analysis cycle rather than trying to win the original cabinet order.

concept: 300C-class mixed-signal instrumentation electronics platform (SiC/SOI) for superhot geothermal, downhole, and turbine environments
timing_window: If superhot drilling slips, the 300C market stays program-funded; oilfield in-house teams may capture the niche for their own tools only.

concept: Precision GaN pump-driver and laser-power modules: nanosecond-class programmable current drive as a merchant subsystem for industrial and defense-adjacent laser OEMs
timing_window: Export-control separability is manageable but sharp-edged: commercial drivers are low-sensitivity; any DEW-affiliated line must be strictly US-entity with no CN ownership links, or US primes will not buy - structure two entities from day one, accept that a forced choice may drop one market (then reassign batch). Chinese OEMs may refuse external drivers (NIH culture) - test willingness in 2028 discovery. FIX: the US(DEW)/commercial two-entity partition is a day-one structural requirement, not a contingency.

concept: Thermal-shock-tolerant printed-circuit heat exchangers (PCHE): merchant diffusion-bonded recuperators for sCO2 power, heat pumps, and hydrogen precooling
timing_window: Export separability: heat exchangers for CN steel/waste-heat retrofits are low-sensitivity; nuclear-qualified US product line kept in US entity (no CN transfer). Risks: sCO2 commercialization slips (kill if no >=10MW-class merchant order by end-2033); Chinese institutes verticalize; manufacturing capex heavier than electronics seeds. All 2026 project schedules must be re-verified 2029.

concept: Sealed negative-pressure (subatmospheric) water/low-GWP two-phase cold-plate loop for >2 kW/chip Chinese AI racks - leak-safe by physics (air leaks in, coolant never leaks out), PFAS-free by design
timing_window: Foreign-founder access: direct sales to Chinese hyperscalers unrealistic; route is IP licensing/joint development with a Chinese thermal vendor (Envicool-class) or ODM design-in via HK entity. Risk that Chinese incumbents productize two-phase in-house before 2030; mitigated by patent position and the documented non-convergence of two-phase architectures.

concept: High-density cryogenic interconnect loader with co-packaged 4K readout front-end (superconducting flex harness + cryo-CMOS multiplexing + cryo-LNA), breaking the 256-channel-per-loader wall for quantum computers.
timing_window: On-chip multiplexing (1000:1) or optical cryo-links could leapfrog external harness density; quantum capex is cyclical and government-dependent. Substitution risks kept on record (from D-17): on-chip 1000:1 multiplexing, SFQ readout, cryo-CMOS moving control fully cold, and optical cryo-links could each leapfrog external harness density; roadmap-validation angle - the only public density roadmap is a single vendor's unvalidated claim, so independent validated density data is itself a wedge.

concept: Field-deployable industrial high-temperature heat-pump commissioning and measurement-and-verification island
timing_window: China's official heat-pump action plan sets 2030 deployment and industrialization objectives, while MIIT's 2026-2028 program explicitly calls for industrial heat pumps and wide-range actual-load efficiency evaluation. The validation window precedes the scale-up and acceptance wave.

concept: Superconducting-magnet electrical balance-of-plant platform: standardized precision drive-and-dump skids (10 ppm-class high-current DC converters + energy-extraction/dump units + current leads + busbars)
timing_window: Fusion schedule slip pushes serial magnet builds past 2034; hedge is research/industrial magnet and accelerator PSU demand that exists regardless of fusion outcomes.

concept: PFAS-free pumped two-phase direct-to-chip cooling loop: hermetic, fluid-agnostic evaporator/condenser subsystem co-qualified with low-GWP non-PFAS working fluids
timing_window: Fluid availability is the binding risk - if no non-PFAS two-phase fluid reaches datacenter-scale qualification by 2031, single-phase water wins another cycle (kill trigger). Export separability good: thermal hardware is uncontrolled; CN entity can localize manufacturing. Do not rely on the unconfirmed Chinese '100% liquid-cooling mandate' (contradicted by primary text, L14-036). FIX: the 2031 fluid-availability kill trigger is retained and extended to cover the subatmospheric-water variant.

concept: Classification-certified DC power and protection stacks for battery-electric and battery-swap inland/coastal vessels (CCS Rules-native string protection, insulation monitoring, containerized-pack power interface)
timing_window: Access is the honest risk: if CATL bundles the full electrical stack with packs, the merchant socket closes; the wedge is non-CATL integrators and class-rule complexity.

concept: Closed-loop UHV chamber conditioning and acceptance-certification systems for China's big-science vacuum supply chain: instrumented vacuum-firing/bakeout stations with measured hydrogen-outgassing endpoints, integrated rate-of-rise/leak/RGA acceptance metrology, and tamper-evident per-chamber certification - sold as equipment plus recurring calibration to the China-registered fabricators who alone may bid HEPS/CEPC-class chamber tenders.
timing_window: CEPC slip is the dominant risk (single lumpy anchor - the exact defect that killed B-12); mitigated by multi-facility cadence (HEPS upgrades, ASIPP, CSNS-class - BINDING P4 pre-promotion condition: >=2 additional chamber-class tenders evidenced, else no promotion) and by equipment+calibration economics that work at fabricator level, not only facility level. Access risk: foreign founder cannot bid tenders directly - sells equipment/certification to eligible fabricators via licensed CN entity; margins mid; IP risk is bench absorption, countered by calibrated reference standards and model updates rather than a one-time transferable recipe.

concept: Vendor-neutral ion-energy-distribution metrology + tailored-waveform bias control retrofit for plasma etch chambers
timing_window: OEMs may lock chamber data behind proprietary interfaces; if generator vendors integrate good-enough IEDF inference by 2030 the retrofit market narrows to process-development labs.

concept: DC-conversion acceptance and commissioning instrumentation: a portable measurement island (swept-impedance bus-stability analyzer, IT-network insulation/ground-fault characterization, hot-swap/inrush transient capture) plus standardized acceptance protocols and signed dossiers, for facilities converting legacy UPS power rooms to 240V/336V/+-400V/800VDC and for vendors qualifying DC shelves - the measurement layer of the DC transition, not another in-path power product.
timing_window: Datacenter-adjacency declared honestly: demand is deliberately anchored to retrofit/acceptance of the EXISTING installed base and per-project commissioning spend, not to incremental AI capex (the downturn-resistant slice, F-19 precedent); a total freeze of DC investment would still slow it - stated, not hidden. Core demand risk: operators may accept vendor self-certification instead of paying for third-party acceptance - the 2029 frame-agreement gate is binding. CN access: services/instrument sales via licensed entity; hardware is copyable, so the moat must be the validated methodology + sequence library + dossier credibility; margins on instrument plus per-project license; State-Grid-facing work is explicitly out of scope (commercial operators/integrators only), avoiding the F-06/C-12 domestic-only trap.

concept: Electrohydrodynamically-pumped two-phase cold plates: field-driven, no-moving-parts per-chip flow control for 3-5 kW AI packages, with a non-PFAS working-fluid plan.
timing_window: EHD is a documented enthusiasm zone: two 2025 reviews note no industrial-scale deployment (L16-003, L16-004); fluid qualification (dielectric + low-GWP + non-PFAS) may not intersect; hyperscalers may brute-force with bigger CDUs. Hard fluid-intersection gate (FIX): the working fluid must simultaneously be dielectric, non-PFAS, and low-GWP; if no candidate passes qualification, kill regardless of EHD results.

concept: PEM electrolyzer 'protective operating envelope' controllers with warranty-grade black-box logging: embedded plant hardware that shapes current/OCV stress and produces bankable degradation evidence
timing_window: If hydrogen FIDs stay depressed (documented order-book contraction), volume never arrives; the device concept then retargets battery/fuel-cell assets (same physics of warranty).

concept: Precision wideband DC current/voltage sensing platform (optical and zero-flux hybrid) for HVDC converter stations, electrolyzer plants, and magnet systems
timing_window: Component-margin business with entrenched incumbents; if HVDC protection stays vertically bundled inside converter OEMs, merchant sensing stays niche.

concept: High-speed permanent-magnet turbo-generator + power-converter 'electrical cartridge' (0.3-20 MW) for waste-heat sCO2 and geothermal/ORC power blocks
timing_window: If sCO2 retrofit demand stays CNNC-internal and ORC incumbents keep generators in-house, the merchant socket is small; mitigated by multi-cycle applicability and the documented turbine capacity shortage.
